title: The Indictment of the Blind and Deaf People
description: The Lord asks his people a sharp question: Who is blind like my servant, and deaf like the messenger I send? The people have seen much but do not take it to heart; their ears are open, yet they do not hear. Although the Lord made the law great and glorious for the sake of his righteousness, the people are plundered and robbed, trapped in snares and hidden in prisons. The prophet explains that it was the Lord himself who handed Jacob over to be plundered and Israel to robbers, because they sinned against him and would not walk in his ways. Therefore he poured out his burning wrath on them, but they did not understand it or take it to heart [ref:Jes 42:18-25|Isaiah 42:18-25].
